label: To the landing at Gibagabar
fresh: Boats lie drawn up on the shingle at Gibagabar, keel to keel, and the houses come right down to them, with nets hung on every fence and an anchor for a doorstop. It stands looking out over the Sharashakawruk, with the fells at its back.
A shepherd’s boy is telling anyone who will listen that something comes up out of Silkholme sink at night and takes a ewe off a pit in the ground, and that Garth means to burn it out.
A plank door, barred on the outside.

Gibagabar is the one place on this shore where a boat can lie safe in a blow, and so everything that comes over the Sharashakawruk comes in here, and most of it stays. A boat is coming in under half its sail, and three people on the quay are telling the crew how to do it.

Rangrim is spreading a net over a wall to dry. Eldis is pumping a bellows with a foot, slow and steady, watching the colour of the fire. Gunnvor is hanging bunches of something grey-green to dry from a line under the eaves. Eberk is walking a strip of barley, pulling the odd weed and looking at the sky between. Floss, the inn’s dog, lies across the doorstep of the Sleepy Griffin with her chin on her paws, and watches who comes.
Floss barks twice, for form’s sake, then comes to see who you are.

label: Into the Sleepy Griffin
fresh: The taproom of the Sleepy Griffin

A busy room in two parts with a counter between, and a stair going up to the rooms. Miners at the long table, grey with dust to the eyebrows. A notice from Merrowdale is nailed up where travellers will see it, and half the talk is of the forty crowns it offers and the other half of why nobody has gone. Everyone here is grumbling about the toll on the road: food is dearer for it, and there is less of it.
At a table by the window Nackle turns a thin old coin over and over in their fingers, and looks up whenever the door opens.
Harbek Loderr the messenger is already at the door, the satchel on, eating as he goes. Vistra the pilgrim stands in the door with a staff, looking at the sky to see what the day will be.
